title: Volume 1 Chapter 2: 7th Squad Edition 1
content: Anti-Demon Corps Records
August 1st, 2:30 PM, Mato Disaster occurred at the 7th Squad's station.
A tourist bus traveling near Hakone Town, Ashigarashimo District, Kanagawa Prefecture, became lost in Mato due to a suddenly appearing gate.
Under the guide's instructions, everyone on the bus remained inside.
The bus was attacked by numerous Shuki, and was overturned by a Shuki with a special appearance.
The 7th Squad arrived and exterminated the Shuki.
Many injuries occurred due to the impact of the overturned bus, but there were no fatalities.
The special Shuki, which had many witnesses, was not found among the defeated Shuki.

Considering the possibility that it passed through the gate into the real world, the search for Shuki in the Hakone area was conducted by ability users specialized in detecting Shuki, but the special Shuki was not discovered.
It is presumed that the special Shuki escaped in the brief time before the Anti-Demon Corps arrived after overturning the bus.
August 4th, 5:10 AM, Mato Disaster occurred at the 7th Squad's station.
A gate appeared, and Nei Okawamura used her ability to detect five Shuki in the vicinity (one of which matched the appearance of the special Shuki that appeared on August 1st).
From there, four Shuki passed through the gate and appeared in the real world, in Kunisaki Town, Oita Prefecture.
Kyouka Uzen and the 7th Squad also passed through the gate and arrived in Kunisaki Town.
They exterminated the Shuki before they could cause any damage in the real world.
The rapid arrival of the 7th Squad and the fact that the location where the Shuki appeared was an uninhabited field were fortunate circumstances.
The special Shuki was observed by Nei Okawamura to have disappeared into the ground without passing through the gate leading to the real world.
This special Shuki, which has the unique ability to quickly hide underground, was named "Kamairika."
August 7th, 10:50 PM, a massive outbreak of Shuki occurred at the 7th Squad's station.
Kamairika was detected by Nei Okawamura among the swarm of Shuki.
However, Kamairika quickly vanished into the ground.
The 7th Squad, having rushed to the scene, exterminated the large number of Shuki.
Some of the Shuki merged to transform into a giant Shuki, but were defeated by Shushu Suruga, who had grown in size due to her ability.
That special Shuki runs away into the ground before the Anti-Demon Corps can arrive.
What a coward,
" Kyouka muttered with annoyance at the difficulty of defeating Kamairika.
"Thanks to its chicken-like nature, there haven't been any casualties," Shushu added.
"That's not true, Shushu. The reason there haven't been any casualties is because everyone has been doing their best."
Kyouka pointed at the image of Kamairika.
Look, it has a good physique.
It's clearly stronger than a typical Shuki.
If we had been even a little slower, it could have been dangerous.
"That's true. Considering that, Nei-chan, your quick discovery is commendable."
"Nei is relieved that there have been no casualties."
A slight hint of fatigue was visible on Nei's face.
"So far, Kamairika has only appeared in our 7th Squad's area," Vice Captain Himari Azuma reported the situation.
"This Kamairika has a characteristic of appearing every three days. Is that just a coincidence?"
Special Shuki have their own personalities.
We should keep an eye on such trends.
The next appearance will be...
August 10th.
We need to be on high alert.
"Yes, we'll strengthen our patrols on the 10th."
I wish we could set up some traps.
They say you can catch beasts that way in the mountains.
I'd love for someone to make traps for Shuki.
I heard there was a prototype capture trap before.
However, the Shuki caught in it reportedly dug through the ground along with the trap.
"Wow, that makes wild bears seem cute."
"If only we could make landmines that only affect Shuki, that would be great."
I heard they tried making traps like landmines, and those were effective, but it takes too much time and effort to create something effective.
After all, we have to distinguish between humans and Shuki.
"If we can't distinguish, it could be disastrous if someone who accidentally wandered into Mato steps on it."
There’s also the possibility of the blast hitting a Shuki that stepped on the landmine...
I guess landmines are too risky.
Anyway, we need to be on high alert for Kamairika.
However, let's not neglect other Shuki just because we're focused on it.
"Yes, Captain."
"Nei, you're tired. Make sure to rest well. Relax."
"Nei Okawamura will rest properly."
"Alright. Dismissed. Good work, everyone."
After the meeting, the members of the 7th Squad returned to their usual duties.
"Hey, Yuki. Clean my room a bit, will you?"
Shushu Suruga said, grabbing Yuki's arm.
"Okay, let's go!"
"You don’t have to drag me, Shushu-chan."
Yuki was led by Shushu to her room.
"Come on, come on, get inside."
And as Yuki was about to enter the room, she pushed him in with her whole body.
"Shushu-chan's room is much tidier than it was at the beginning."
Yuki admired as he looked around Shushu's room.
"Well, of course."
"But you’re overlooking the small dirt spots. That’s why you called me, right? Leave it to me."
Yuki happily started cleaning.
Shushu watched him intently.
"What’s wrong?"
"Yuki, you used to clean reluctantly at first."
"Back then, it was more than just cleaning; there were panties lying around."
"Ah, I remember that well."
"Of course you do."
"That’s true."
Shushu laughed cheerfully.
"You were happy to see a high school girl's panties, weren't you?"
"Ahem. By the way, Shushu-chan, you haven’t gone to high school at all, have you? Nei-chan goes to school regularly."
"It’s summer vacation now."
"But it seems like you weren’t going even before that."
"Well, after experiencing the excitement of Mato, high school feels too boring."
"So it sounds like you won't be going back to high school?"
Looks like it.
Of course, I could attend if I wanted to, but I prefer Mato.
Plus, there’s that super handsome manager.
"Stop teasing me."
"But Yuki, you look better than when you first came here."
"Really?"
"Yeah, after repeatedly fighting Shuki, it’s only natural you’d change."
"That’s nice to hear."
"Your physique has improved too."
Shushu lightly tapped Yuki's stomach.
"By the way, Yuki, when’s your break?"
"In three hours."
"Can we play a little game?"
"I might fall asleep."
"If that happens, you can sleep here. How about we play some retro games for a change?"
Shushu showed Yuki a retro game cartridge she had.
"Oh, you have one of these too?"
"I got it sent from home. Want to play?"
"I want to play, I want to play!"
"Okay, I’ll be waiting for the break."
As she said this, Shushu watched Yuki clean.
"Hey, Yuki, you weren’t popular in high school, were you?"
"Yeah, sadly so."
"With how good you are at housework."
"Sports and smart people are the ones who get popular."
"Maybe the girls around you just didn’t have good taste."
"Alright, I’m done cleaning."
"Impressive. You’re moving your mouth while moving your hands."
Shushu applauded Yuki.
"Well, I’m going to take a little nap."
"Okay, good night."
"Hey, you."
"Yes?"
After finishing cleaning Shushu's room briskly, Yuki was called by Himari Azuma.
"I have patrol in an hour and a half, but I want to eat ramen before I go."
"Sure, one ramen coming right up. What kind of ramen do you want?"
Himari often made some pretty outrageous requests for ramen, like something creative or summery.
But Yuki was eager to meet her requests as much as possible.
"Today, I want a classic soy sauce ramen. Make the noodles a bit firm."
"Got it, I’ll give it a try."
"Talking about ramen is making me hungry already."
"You have a very straightforward body."
"Oh, that sounded a bit suggestive!"
"Isn’t it more suggestive that you immediately connect it that way?"
"Huh? ...Wait, this isn’t the time to be playing around, I have work."
"That’s true."
While he sometimes prepared the broth in advance, this time he made it after the order, using pork broth instead of bones.
"It smells good."
"Would you like some ramen too, Kyouka-san?"
"No, I’m fine for now."
After replenishing her fluids and patting Yuki on the shoulder in appreciation, Kyouka returned to her work.
With his master’s encouragement, Yuki put even more effort into finishing the ramen.
When the ramen was ready, Himari Azuma was happily eating it.
"Mm, this is good ramen. This is what I’m talking about."
"What made you like ramen so much?"
"I just like it because it’s delicious, no particular reason."
"Well, I guess that’s how favorites are."
There are so many varieties of ramen that I never get bored.
I want to conquer all the local ramen from around Japan someday.
"Please don’t ask me to learn and master all the flavors from different regions."
"That would be really unreasonable, so I won’t. I think you can only get 100% of the flavor in the local area."
"That’s quite a stoic opinion."
"Ramen is passion."
Saying this, Himari finished her ramen.
"Thank you for the meal. I’ll head out for patrol now."
"Be careful."
Himari, satisfied, energetically dashed out for her patrol.
As Yuki was ironing his clothes after seeing her off, Nei came into the living room.
Nei was gulping down milk stored in the refrigerator.
"Nei-chan, you don’t seem fully recovered from your fatigue, do you?"
"My shoulders are a bit tense."
After finishing ironing, Yuki touched Nei's shoulder.
"Wow, Nei-chan, your shoulders are stiff for an elementary school student."
"I have friends in the same grade who also struggle with shoulder stiffness."
"Is that so?"
"I’m usually fine, but I overused my ability a bit."
"Your ability, the clairvoyance?"
"It’s dangerous to let the special Shuki go down quickly. I have to discover them as soon as possible."
"So you kept using your clairvoyance, and that’s why your shoulders..."
"I wish my body was as sturdy as the Captain's."
"Kyouka-san is an exception."
Recently, while defeating a large number of Shuki, Kyouka had taken a hit from an enemy attack.
This was a rare occurrence. Normally, a Captain wouldn’t take damage from Shuki.
Yet Kyouka remained unfazed, saying she would be fine as long as she focused her energy.
Yuki thought that anyone other than Kyouka would definitely not be fine.
"Nei-chan, can I give you a little massage?"
"Yes, please. I still have a bit of my break left."
Yuki carefully massaged Nei's small shoulders.
Being an elementary school student, he made sure not to apply strong pressure, gently pressing on the pressure points and softly massaging her shoulders.
"Ahhh."
"Are you okay, Nei-chan?"
"Ah, that feels good."
Her voice was completely relaxed.
"Good."
Afterward, Yuki placed a warm steamed towel over Nei's eyes.
"This feels nice."
"Please stay like that for a while, my superior."
"Aren't you working too hard, Yuki?"
"I'm fine, my break is coming up soon."
"That’s good to hear. Make sure to rest properly when you do... okay?"
"Nei-chan?"
Before he knew it, Nei had fallen asleep; she must have been quite tense.
"Kamairika or whatever. That special Shuki, I need to do something about it soon."
Yuki kept an eye on Nei while doing housework.
Now that it was his break time, Yuki made a phone call.
He was returning a call from his friend Suwa.
"Hey, Yuki, long time no see."
"Oh, I got your call."
"It’s not like something happened, I just wanted to know how you’re doing in Mato."
"I'm doing well."
"Since you’re in the Anti-Demon Corps, it’s been hard to contact you, but I’ve really wanted to hear your voice."
"Now that you mention it, I’ve been so focused on the Anti-Demon Corps that I haven’t been able to contact anyone."
"Yeah, I feel the same. It’s tough being a new employee."
Suwa had gotten a job in a company in the real world.
"But your boss, Kyouka-san, is super beautiful. That’s something I really envy."
"When she’s too beautiful, it makes me a bit nervous."
"Ha, that’s a luxurious problem."
"What about your workplace?"
I’m being worked hard by older women in sales.
Every time something tough happens, I think about wanting to see you guys.
"Oh, let’s go eat sometime."
"Really? Can you make time?"
"I can make some time."
"Let’s go, let’s go. I’d like to go every week if possible."
"Make sure to invite Hattori too."
"Take care of yourself. Mato is like being in a battlefield, right?"
"Yeah, thanks."
After ending the call, Yuki headed to Shushu's room.
"I’ve been waiting for you, Yuki! Let’s play a game, a game!"
Shushu displayed the retro games she had.
"I have this many."
"I have a friend who has cartridge games. I borrowed a few, like this F-MEGA."
"We tend to compete, so let’s do a cooperative play shooting game."
"I know this one where you collect bells, I know, I know."
Yuki and Shushu enjoyed playing games for a while.
While Yuki was cleaning the dormitory bathroom, Nei came in.
"Nei-chan, do you want to take a bath? Sorry, just a moment."
"I'm fine, I already took one. It’s almost bedtime."
"Thanks for your hard work today."
"Yuki-san, I have a favor to ask. Can you watch over me while I sleep?"
"Eh?"
"I need to sleep well to recover my strength. But when I think about sleeping, I feel like I can’t."
"I get that, I really do."
"Today, when you massaged me, I fell asleep. I wanted to try that again."
"Getting you to sleep is something Kyouka-san is better at... oh, Kyouka-san is out for a meeting right now."
If she dulls her clairvoyance, it might delay her detection, which could endanger lives.
That’s why Nei wants to rest properly and recover her strength.
Understanding Nei's feelings, Yuki decided to stay and watch her sleep.
Nei's room was tidy, requiring almost no maintenance from Yuki.
To make it easier for her to sleep, Yuki lay down next to Nei, matching her gaze.
